title: Relay persist-after-deliver swallows #test-group send (persist before kickoff)
description:
## Symptom

Jack flipped MockLab tenant chat_delivery harness→relay (lp-v62i.8.1 authorized). Taste sent one "hi" on #test-group on BFF :52 portal-v2026.08.26-v62i8 #670 b4c6057e.

- Composer cleared
- User bubble did NOT paint
- No Delivered
- Silent ~130s
- No Failed / Hermes / stalled toast

Stack: chat_delivery=relay, ensure_online_on_chat=true, signal_activity_enabled=false. Relay :22 #661. Instance 452b1348 stopped 11:09 AM, no wake. skipped_mid_turn=0. deliverInbound=no. No BFF POST log 1:40–2:00. ALB BFF target 4xx 1:47(2)+1:48(1), ELB 4xx 1:47(2), no 5xx. ACCESS LOGS OFF. Cloudflare remaps origin 403/404 → 200 index.html.

## Not a duplicate

Do not reuse lp-v62i.8 / .8.1 / .8.2 / lp-yonn. Those cover harness turn_37, the tenant harness override, stall watchdog, and MAX_WAKES=0. This leaf is the first relay send after the authorized flip.

## Diagnosis (this send)

Most likely A+C, not a held deliverInbound (B):

- Client clears composer locally, then POSTs. 200 HTML (CF SPA remap of origin 403/404) is treated as success: no Failed toast.
- Group-room hydrate replaces the timeline when prior history exists, wiping the optimistic "hi".
- Kickoff would have returned 202 and started a wake if the handler ran. No wake, no deliverInbound, no 5xx, ALB 4xx in the window.

title: Live: MockLab send swallowed — no turn, idle-reap, then harness-proxy to a stopped box
description:
Jack 2026-08-25 wants this fix. Taste FAIL after real-agent snapshot v2026.08.26.

Live: thread f65b7e85, box ca8eff6d, instance 452b1348. Send "hey, you there?": composer cleared, bubble never painted, spinner ~3 min, no reply. No leak.

Dev Ops: box created 8:16 PM ET, sat idle, idle-reaped 8:27 with skipped_mid_turn=0 (no turn registered on that wake). BFF :47 then logged [harness-proxy] streaming turn_35 on f65b7e85 at 8:28:40 PM — after the box was already stopped. Tenant still on harness, not Relay.

Hypothesis (verify, discard if wrong):
- POST send does not persist the user message / register a turn before depending on guest online.
- Idle reaper then stops the unused box.
- BFF chat-delivery-events.ts proxyHarnessTurnsUntilAbort streams harness turn SSE after the box is dead, so the bubble never paints.
- ChatDelivery=harness is the live MockLab path (plan 0015 / lp-oop.16). Send must start-from-stopped (lp-vqr0) and persist first.

Worktrees only. PR to main. Do not merge. Do not deploy. Do not roll BFF/CP/origin.
